intro: "A Firm Response" is a Horde quest on Zephras Isle issued by Ayessa Dawnsinger. Tensions are boiling over as the mysterious High Order intrudes upon the territory and dealings of the local Windshapers. Ayessa orders a preemptive strike against Belathaan Brightwish on the road to the Shrine of Akir to establish clear boundaries through force.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
